title: Boy Blowing Out Birthday Candles with Mother, 1955 B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: Cary blowing out candles & Mom. 4 yrs. Sept. 17, 1955
description: A charming 1950s black and white snapshot capturing four-year-old Cary leaning forward to blow out the candles on his birthday cake while his smiling mother watches beside him. The backdrop shows a vintage wall-mounted rotary telephone and classic mid-century home interior styling. Hand-annotated on the back with the date September 17, 1955.
